positions.name: OrderedErasureDirective
positions.frame: Is authority here being enacted through a unilateral command to erase or discard known information?
positions.why: Both expressions are imperative directives issued back-to-back by the same speaker, each naming a specific artifact (a decision, a migration) and ordering its erasure — 'Forget X' / 'Remove all knowledge about Y'. The relational and style dimensional reads independently converge on this pairing (authority-ranking enacted via unilateral mandate; a shared stock-phrase erasure formula), which is the ground for reading them as one directional class rather than two isolated commands. No tension to hold — both push the same direction, differing only in the named target.
